subject: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: luis.rodriguez@hypercloud.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment

Hi Luis —

Thanks again for the call today. We ran through the onboarding plan for AcmeAI (DEAL-4392) and wanted to document a small change to the approach that will help protect their SLO while we wait for the OEM hardware shipment.

Ask / context: Acme has asked for a dedicated pool of 4x A100-class GPUs to start (burst to 8 within 60 days). Their expected go-live is 2026-11-01. OEM lead times from Stratus are currently quoted at 14–18 weeks, and HyperCloud has offered a short-term reserved capacity hold but only on a 30-day window unless we provide a PO.

Proposal: can HyperCloud hold a 4-node reserved buffer for the first 45 days of onboarding (will consume as a bridge) while Stratus confirms shipment ETA? In return we can sign a non-binding PO commitment for a phased procurement (initial 4 nodes, then optional 4 nodes after the 60-day marker) and include a short SLA exception during the bridge period.

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP-draft-4392.xlsx) and the Stratus quote we received yesterday (OEM-quote-Stratus-2026-08-14.pdf).

Timing: we need a written hold by EOD Thu 2026-08-19 to keep Acme’s onboarding window intact.

Can you confirm whether HyperCloud can: 1) hold the 4-node buffer for 45 days without a full PO, and 2) if so, whether the hold can be backstopped by a simple acceptance form (we can sign and return capacity-hold-form.pdf)?

Thanks — appreciate quick signal so we can finalize the MAP with Acme.

— Jasmine Liu
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: luis.rodriguez@hypercloud.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stratus-oem.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear summary. Short answers:
1) We can hold a 4-node reserved buffer for 30 days without a PO. Extending to 45 days is possible but will require a courtesy hold/acceptance form (legal sign-off on our side) and a nominal deposit to cover the reservation.
2) We’ll accept the capacity-hold-form.pdf if Redwood signs and returns within 48 hours.

Note on pricing: if Stratus confirms shipment >12 weeks out, HyperCloud can kick in a discounted bridging rate (we’ll reduce the per-hour commitment by 10% for the first 45 days) 

I’ve looped in procurement@stratus-oem.com to confirm whether the Stratus ETA can be tightened or whether they have earlier build slots to swap into.

— Luis
Head of Cloud Partnerships, HyperCloud

On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 09:30 AM jasmine.liu@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks Luis — copying Stratus so we can get a single path for ETA reconciliation.
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment

Quick internal sync —

Notes:
- Marcus: please confirm whether the Dedicated team can accept a 45-day capacity hold backed by a deposit rather than a full PO. If yes, we need the exact wording for the acceptance form so HyperCloud’s legal can mirror it.
- Neha: procurement will need the Stratus quote redline (I flagged a warranty clause that needs tightening).
- We should avoid a full SLA exception if possible; prefer a scoped temporary SLO amendment limited to the bridge window.

Attachment referenced in-line: OEM-quote-Stratus-2026-08-14.pdf (see p2 for lead time table).

Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment

I pulled the Stratus quote and the warranty/lead-time terms look standard but the delivery SLA has a force-majeure clause that would allow for >30-day slips without penalty. Two asks:
1) Marcus — can infra accept a provisional acceptance form that contains an explicit 45-day bridge cap and an automatic failover to HyperCloud at the discounted bridging rate if Stratus shipping shifts beyond the cap? We need the concrete fallback trigger (e.g., 14 days beyond expected ship date).
2) Jasmine/Ben — when you share the MAP with Acme, make the PO conditional on the phased procurement (initial order + optional follow-on) rather than a single unconditional commitment. That keeps legal comfortable while giving Acme the ramp they want.

I’ll prepare a redline to the Stratus quote and draft the acceptance deposit language. Targeting a redline version by Fri 2026-08-21 EOD.

— Neha
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: luis.rodriguez@hypercloud.com, procurement@stratus-oem.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Buffered onboarding windows & vendor signal — capacity and quote alignment

Thanks all — short update and concrete next steps so Acme’s onboarding window stays intact: 

1) HyperCloud: confirm provisional 45-day hold is approved provided Redwood returns capacity-hold-form.pdf and posts a refundable deposit (we understand the deposit amount and acceptance language will be finalized by your team). Please send the acceptance form to neha.kapoor@redwood.ai by Mon 2026-08-24.
2) Stratus: Neha will send a redline to OEM-quote-Stratus-2026-08-14.pdf with an explicit 45-day delivery cap and a defined fallback trigger. Please review and return with an updated ETA slot by Tue 2026-08-25.
3) Redwood internal: Ben & Marcus — incorporate the 45-day bridge and fallback clause in the MAP and in the rollout schedule. Ben — please update the MAP spreadsheet (sheet: onboarding-timeline) and send to Acme by Wed 2026-08-26.
4) Acme: we’ll present the conditional phased PO (initial 4 nodes, optional +4 after 60 days) and the MAP with the bridge language and the deposit requirement.

Attachments included for signatures: capacity-hold-form.pdf (placeholder), MAP-draft-4392.xlsx

If we have written acceptance from HyperCloud by EOD Mon 2026-08-24, we can preserve Acme’s 2026-11-01 go-live target without shifting the onboarding sprint.

Best —
Jasmine
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
